contract.host_status_unchanged: CardStatusV1 and existing e_paper.update_result argument meanings are preserved.

purpose: Portable panel adapter telemetry for WB55 dry-run status and future WBA real-panel driver pressure checks.

telemetry_fields.attempted_count: display requests accepted by the adapter dispatcher
telemetry_fields.controller_known: current target configuration has controller identity and dimensions
telemetry_fields.error_count: bad transport or target callback failures except BUSY
telemetry_fields.hardware_present: current target configuration says panel hardware is present
telemetry_fields.last_result: last comp_epaper_panel_result_t value observed by the dispatcher
telemetry_fields.last_result_valid: at least one adapter result has been observed
